verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm, but it says it uses legal tech and AI-based systems and runs a software-supported ySolutions unit, so an official MCP server is at least conceivable. The evidence pack contains no MCP server, no API, and no agent integration; probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
